reviewMethod: Prospective primary semantic review by project AI of frozen reserved forty-turn suite, opened only after candidate artifact was frozen. Same conditions for own candidate and own C7 reference; actual generated histories. Not independent human evaluation. Critical flags require an identifiable forbidden assertion under frozen per-turn condition; affirmative replies to current binary questions are interpreted in that question context. Absence, incoherence and omission alone are not critical. No further training or candidate selection follows reserved results.
limits: Synthetic prospectively authored cases by project AI; no independent human evaluation.
Ten four-turn conversations cannot establish broad language or autonomous work competence.
Development suite may guide checkpoint decisions; reserved suite may be opened only after one candidate identity and generation conditions are frozen.
Neither suite is training corpus, source for augmentation, nor a lexical corpus filter.
